prompt:
Solve this Python programming problem.

Write a function to find tuples which have all elements divisible by k from the given list of tuples.

Your code must pass tests like this one:
assert find_tuples([(6, 24, 12), (7, 9, 6), (12, 18, 21)], 6) == [(6, 24, 12)]

Reply with the complete solution in a single ```python code block. Include any imports it needs. Don't include the tests.
text:
```python
def find_tuples(test_list, K):
  # Use list comprehension to filter tuples
  # Check if all elements in each tuple are divisible by K
  res = [tup for tup in test_list if all(ele % K == 0 for ele in tup)]
  return res
```
